deviations.what: Around the checklist, Home is today's S1: an app bar titled 'Home' and, with two books (O8b–O8f), the two-chip scope toggle where the frames draw the scope pill with the person's name and a bell; the 'Balanced' verification card and the hero's 'Cash A/c ₹0' line where the frames draw 'Nothing recorded yet'; the shell's centre (+) in the tab bar; so 'Today · 6 Oct' is below the fold
deviations.reason: This slice owns the checklist card; the rest of Home is S1's re-skin (S1.json), the toggle is 13 §2.2's two-book control, the verification card is required on Home, and the tab bar is the shell's
deviations.authority: 07 §4 🔒 (verification card); 13 §2.2 🔒 (two chips for two books); S1 re-skin and shell (+) — open P1A

deviations.what: Money in ↓ / Money out ↑ arrows in full ink where the frames tint them green and red
deviations.reason: The tints are the credit/debit tokens, kept for amounts only; the word under each arrow carries the direction

deviations.what: 'Add your family' carries no chevron and does not answer a tap (O8)
deviations.reason: Its door is S9 Members, another feature's screen, and no doc says which book it opens from Home; a chevron with nowhere to go would be a dead end

deviations.what: O8d draws the trust book in scope (hero ₹1,21,000 across Cash A/c · Gollak · Bank); the capture keeps the personal book in scope at ₹0
deviations.reason: The capture shows the same checklist state (branch row ticked and struck, chevron, no ⋮); which book Home opens on is the scope holder's (13 §2.2), not the checklist's

deviations.what: O8e: the open ⋮ menu does not dim the page or tint the row behind it. Placement matches: the menu hangs under the Finish row, right edge on the ⋮, with the row in view (a row in the lower half of the list is scrolled up first, so the menu lands inside the list, not over the verbs)
deviations.reason: Flutter's showMenu has no scrim and no anchor-row highlight; the card itself is drawn as the frame draws it (paper, hairline, ✕ + 'Not needed' + the line under it), anchored on the row's box (SETUP174 review finding 3, fixed)
deviations.authority: design-system (hairlines over shadows, tokens.dart); Material showMenu

deviations.what: O8e: 'Menu › Members' where the frame writes 'Menu → Members'
deviations.reason: No bundled face (Mukta, Mukta Mahee, Noto Sans) carries U+2192, so → is a tofu box on the capture and a system-face fallback on a phone; › is in Mukta
deviations.authority: 11 §4.4 (the bundled faces); ADR 2026-10-05 §2 (no text outside the design faces)

deviations.what: O8f: none in placement — the toast's bottom edge meets the verb buttons' top (it overlaps only the bar's hairline and top padding, as the frame draws it) and leaves on its own after 10 s; the residual difference is only that Home above it is taller (deviation 1)
deviations.reason: Lifted by the measured verb-bar height; duration 10 s with persist:false (Flutter 3.47 otherwise keeps a SnackBar with an action up until tapped). SETUP174 review finding 2, fixed; F1-1007-5 asserts both
deviations.authority: 13 §4.2 (toast — the 10 s Undo); 07 §1 rules 1–2 🔒 (verbs stay in reach)

deviations.what: At 200 % text the tick sits above the row's words and the chevrons go; the ⋮ stays beside the tick
deviations.reason: A Gurmukhi/Devanagari word at 200 % on a 360-wide phone needs the card's full width; 'Not needed' must stay reachable
